The file imports only a schema from `pack`, so `pack`'s `svc.method` is never bound in the file, and the check must still see it. PATH PINNED: dsc.driver.lcrs_14_9_duplicate_services, the file against one library, DS_VALIDATE_DUPLICATE_SERVICE.
